coverage: colored: events 236(x2 lambda),322,34(high boost); EW: events 438(low),417(high) -- both benchmarks, both boost classes, colored at 2 lambda values covered; full 16-run grid not completed due to extreme per-run cost, capped per task bounded-profile intent
mechanistic_explanation: Step count scales as t_max/dt, where dt is set to hit a validated 300-steps-per-period floor and period ~ 1/Lambda^2 (Eq.4). Higher Lambda -> shorter period -> more steps needed to cover the same physical flight time to the outer detector layer. Confirmed empirically: colored event 236 at Lambda=5keV took 7.1x longer than at Lambda=2keV (1429s vs 201s), consistent with the (5/2)^2=6.25 scaling expectation.
